chunks: From him, from Ibn Mahbub, from 'Ali ibn Ri'ab, from Zurarah, from Abu Ja'far عليه السلام, who said:
Any man upon whom punishments have come together, among which is killing, then one begins with the punishments that are short of killing, then he is killed.

key_terms.يُبْدَأُ: it is begun; priority is given
key_terms.يُقْتَلُ: he is killed; the execution is carried out
key_terms.ٱلْقَتْلُ: execution or killing as a legal punishment

ai.seo_question: If multiple hadd punishments apply to a person and one of them is execution, which punishment is carried out first?
ai.summary: This hadith gives a legal ruling concerning a person upon whom multiple hadd punishments have become due, including one that entails execution. It states that the lesser punishments are carried out first, and then the execution is carried out afterward.
